query: lua local p=vim.fn.fnamemodify(%s,":p"); local i=vim.fn.getscriptinfo({name=p})[1];local out={}; if i then for _,m in ipairs({"n","x","s","o","i","c","t"}) do for _,k in ipairs(vim.api.nvim_get_keymap(m)) do if k.sid==i.sid then table.insert(out,{mode=m,lhs=k.lhs,rhs=k.rhs or "",lnum=k.lnum,desc=k.desc or ""}) end end end end vim.fn.writefile({vim.json.encode(out)}, %s)
